label: WRONG
reason: Engine-side code throws typed EngineError/TestError/ConfigurationError via helpers like unsupported() (actions.ts, links.ts, support.ts), but the provider-facing lease module throws bare Error throughout (lease/index.ts, and unlisted daemon.ts assertSessionsEnded/agentDeviceBin), as do provider packages (testmu sessions.ts), because LeasedDevices wraps provider failures into EngineError via allOrFirstFailure (provider.ts); new lease code would be flagged for following its module's style. Nothing in .oxlintrc.json enforces it. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since typed errors are clearly the engine's contract.

reason: Screens render <Text> because they show copy (ApplePay.tsx, LoginForm.tsx); App.tsx is the single root navigator composing the scenarios (one_off) and BottomTabs.tsx is a Tab.Navigator shell whose tab components carry the text, so a new navigator-only component would be flagged for nothing.

label: WRONG
reason: Members use <View> as their layout container (ApplePay.tsx, LoginForm.tsx), but BottomTabs.tsx's exported screen is a Tab.Navigator and TextInputs.tsx deliberately lays out with KeyboardAvoidingView and ScrollView for a keyboard form; screens rooted in a navigator or scroll container are a legitimate recurring variant, not drift, and nothing lints it.
